description: This Java class, DefaultUpdaterConfig, implements the UpdaterConfig interface and provides configuration handling for updater parameters such as max idle time, bulk size, sharding interval, event processing activation, and background sync configuration. It reads configuration values from a typesafe Config object and supports instantiation via static factory method.

classes.name: DefaultUpdaterConfig
classes.description: Final class that provides immutable configuration data for the updater, including timing parameters, size limits, and background sync configurations, initialized from a Config object.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultUpdaterConfig from a given Config object.

methods.name: getMaxIdleTime
methods.description: Getter for maximum idle time duration.

methods.name: getMaxBulkSize
methods.description: Getter for maximum bulk size for updates.

methods.name: getShardingStatePollInterval
methods.description: Getter for the interval at which sharding state is polled.

methods.name: isEventProcessingActive
methods.description: Indicates whether event processing is active.

methods.name: getBackgroundSyncConfig
methods.description: Getter for the background synchronization configuration.
